text:
sam_cs: FYI onboarding with LumenHealth hitting intermittent 401s + 429s during CI warmup. They say it flaps for ~30s then recovers. Logs attached. :eyes:

devon_engineer: can you paste a sanitized request + headers from their capture?

sam_cs: pasted below.

sam_cs: POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.1
User-Agent: LumenClient/1.2.0
x-rwmeta: eyJhbGciOi... (base64 blob)
Note: our node SDK sends keep-alive + the telemetry header above.

mia_support: that x-rwmeta can push total header size over nginx proxy_buffer_size -> truncation. if Authorization gets chopped, upstream -> 401. The 429s look like retries stacking when CI spikes.

devon_engineer: do we have repro? CI run concurrency?

sam_cs: repro: run their test suite with --concurrency=50 on a single runner. Observed ~5-10% 401s for first 20-30s, then a burst of 429s as clients retry in tight loops. They use node sdk v0.8.1.

devon_engineer: hypothesis: proxy truncates headers -> some requests unauthenticated -> client retries immediately -> rate limiter trips -> 429s. Mitigations: 1) reduce client concurrency during warmup 2) add jittered exponential backoff on retries 3) avoid large telemetry header on cold starts 4) increase proxy buffer or drop non-essential headers.

sam_cs: customer wants the minimal changes path. Can SDK auto-fallback if auth header looks malformed? that seems risky.

mia_support: short-term playbook: suggest they lower parallel jobs to 8-12 while warming, add random 0-200ms jitter on retry, and temporarily disable the heavy telemetry flag. Also add a small soft-circuit in their test harness to pause new inits for 3-5s if 401 rate > 3%. Docs note added.

devon_engineer: I'll prepare a small SDK patch: when concurrency > 10, avoid embedding full x-rwmeta header and keep Authorization last in header order. Also include an opt-in preflight coalescing flag. Will open PR.

devon_engineer: quick snippet we recommend for CI until patch deploys:
```bash
export RW_SDK_CONCURRENCY=10
export RW_SDK_RETRY_JITTER_MS=200
# run tests
```

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: node-sdk/patch-preflight-1427 -> staging (canary 20%).

sam_cs: great — I'll send LumenHealth the CI checklist + ask them to test staging canary. :thumbsup:

mia_support: follow-up: capture the length of their x-rwmeta blob (base64 len) so we can add heuristic to warn when header size > 6KB.

sam_cs: noted. collecting that now. will update thread when customer verifies staging. Thanks all.
